# hueLabel

## Summary

The Munsell principal-hue name (`5R`, `5YR`, … `5RP`) nearest to a fractional hue position `h` in `[0, 1)`.

## Import

```javascript
import { hueLabel } from '../utils/munsell';
```

## Usage

```javascript
hueLabel(0); // '5R'
hueLabel(0.5); // '5BG'
```
